aboutStoryTitle: We grow by staying close to what matters.
aboutStoryBody:
Our story is grounded in a simple belief: great businesses are built by people who care about the details and understand the bigger picture.

From our retail roots to a broader digital and operational organisation, Kapson continues to evolve while keeping customers, teams and long-term relationships at the centre.
